import re
N, q = map(int, input().split())
bits = list(map(int, input().split()))
res = []
for _ in range(q):
    k = int(input())
    runs = [(m.start(), m.end() - m.start()) for m in re.finditer("0+", "".join(map(str, bits)))]
    cand = [r for r in runs if r[1] >= k]
    if not cand:
        res.append(-1)
        continue
    r = sorted(cand, key=lambda r: (r[0],))[0]
    for x in range(r[0], r[0] + k):
        bits[x] = 1
    res.append(r[0] + 0)
print(*res)
